users_stakeholders: Customers, customer-service representatives, operations, technology staff and accountable managers.

Interfaces and permissions are hypothetical, not observed integrations.

time_horizon: Prospective technology-significance judgment; local application considered over the next 12 months. No date of civilizational transformation is predicted.
